*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: src/server/queries.ts
+import type { AnalyticsSummary, CartSummary, CatalogResult, CatalogSearch, PromptCard } from '~/types/market'
+import { DB_USER_ID } from './seed'
+import { getDb } from './db'
+
+const cardSelect = `
+  p.id, p.title, p.slug, p.model, p.category, p.price_cents AS priceCents, p.sold,
+  p.rating, p.creator_id AS creatorId, c.name AS creator, p.aspect_ratio AS aspectRatio,
+  p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.description, p.created_at AS createdAt,
+  ROUND((p.sold * 0.58) + (p.rating * 220) + CASE WHEN p.price_cents = 0 THEN 280 ELSE 0 END + (julianday('2026-07-08') - julianday(p.created_at)) * -8, 2) AS rankScore,
+  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM favorites f WHERE f.user_id = @userId AND f.prompt_id = p.id) AS isFavorite,
+  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cart_items ci WHERE ci.user_id = @userId AND ci.prompt_id = p.id) AS isInCart
+  FROM prompts p JOIN creators c ON c.id = p.creator_id
+`
+
+type RawCard = Omit<PromptCard, 'isFavorite' | 'isInCart'> & { isFavorite: 0 | 1; isInCart: 0 | 1 }
+
+function normalizeCard(row: RawCard): PromptCard {
+  return { ...row, isFavorite: Boolean(row.isFavorite), isInCart: Boolean(row.isInCart) }
+}
+
+export function getCatalog(search: CatalogSearch = {}, userId = DB_USER_ID): CatalogResult {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const filters = ['1=1']
+  const params: Record<string, string | number> = { userId }
+  if (search.model && search.model !== 'all') {
+    filters.push('p.model = @model')
+    params.model = search.model
+  }
+  if (search.category && search.category !== 'all') {
+    filters.push('p.category = @category')
+    params.category = search.category
+  }
+  if (search.query) {
+    filters.push('(p.title LIKE @query OR p.description LIKE @query OR c.name LIKE @query)')
+    params.query = `%${search.query}%`
+  }
+  if (search.favoriteOnly) filters.push('EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM favorites f WHERE f.user_id = @userId AND f.prompt_id = p.id)')
+  const orderBy = search.sort === 'newest' ? 'p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC' : search.sort === 'popular' ? 'p.sold DESC, p.rating DESC' : 'rankScore DESC'
+  const prompts = db.prepare(`${cardSelect} WHERE ${filters.join(' AND ')} ORDER BY ${orderBy}`).all(params).map((row) => normalizeCard(row as RawCard))
+  const counts = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
+      SUM(CASE WHEN price_cents = 0 OR sold >= 3000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS featured,
+      SUM(CASE WHEN price_cents = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free,
+      SUM(CASE WHEN price_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid,
+      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM favorites WHERE user_id = @userId) AS favorites,
+      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = @userId) AS cart
+    FROM prompts
+  `).get({ userId }) as CatalogResult['counts']
+  const categories = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT p.category AS name, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price_cents), 0) AS revenueCents
+    FROM prompts p LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.prompt_id = p.id
+    GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY name
+  `).all() as CatalogResult['categories']
+  const models = db.prepare('SELECT model AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM prompts GROUP BY model ORDER BY model').all() as CatalogResult['models']
+  return { prompts, counts, categories, models }
+}
+
+export function getPrompt(slug: string, userId = DB_USER_ID) {
+  const row = getDb().prepare(`${cardSelect} WHERE p.slug = @slug`).get({ slug, userId }) as RawCard | undefined
+  return row ? normalizeCard(row) : null
+}
+
+export function toggleFavorite(promptId: number, userId = DB_USER_ID) {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const exists = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').get(userId, promptId)
+  if (exists) db.prepare('DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').run(userId, promptId)
+  else db.prepare('INSERT INTO favorites VALUES (?, ?)').run(userId, promptId)
+  return { isFavorite: !exists, count: Number((db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ?').get(userId) as { count: number }).count) }
+}
+
+export function setCartItem(promptId: number, add: boolean, userId = DB_USER_ID) {
+  const db = getDb()
+  if (add) db.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cart_items VALUES (?, ?, 1)').run(userId, promptId)
+  else db.prepare('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').run(userId, promptId)
+  return getCart(userId)
+}
+
+export function getCart(userId = DB_USER_ID): CartSummary {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const items = db.prepare(`${cardSelect} JOIN cart_items cart ON cart.prompt_id = p.id WHERE cart.user_id = @userId ORDER BY cart.prompt_id`).all({ userId }).map((row) => normalizeCard(row as RawCard))
+  const subtotalCents = Number((db.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.price_cents * ci.qty), 0) AS subtotal FROM cart_items ci JOIN prompts p ON p.id = ci.prompt_id WHERE ci.user_id = ?').get(userId) as { subtotal: number }).subtotal)
+  const feeCents = Math.round(subtotalCents * 0.08)
+  return { items, subtotalCents, feeCents, totalCents: subtotalCents + feeCents }
+}
+
+export function checkout(userId = DB_USER_ID) {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const cart = getCart(userId)
+  if (cart.items.length === 0) return { ok: false, orderId: null, cart }
+  const tx = db.transaction(() => {
+    const result = db.prepare('INSERT INTO orders (user_id, status, fee_cents, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, date(\'now\'))').run(userId, 'paid', cart.feeCents)
+    const orderId = Number(result.lastInsertRowid)
+    for (const item of cart.items) db.prepare('INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)').run(orderId, item.id, item.priceCents, item.creatorId)
+    db.prepare('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ?').run(userId)
+    return orderId
+  })
+  return { ok: true, orderId: tx(), cart: getCart(userId) }
+}
+
+export function getAnalytics(): AnalyticsSummary {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const money = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.price_cents), 0) AS grossRevenueCents,
+      COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.price_cents * c.commission_rate)), 0) AS creatorRevenueCents,
+      COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
+      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits) AS visits
+    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN creators c ON c.id = oi.creator_id
+    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
+  `).get() as { grossRevenueCents: number; creatorRevenueCents: number; orders: number; visits: number }
+  const categoryRevenue = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT p.category, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price_cents), 0) AS revenueCents, COUNT(*) AS units
+    FROM order_items oi JOIN prompts p ON p.id = oi.prompt_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
+    WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenueCents DESC
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['categoryRevenue']
+  const creators = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT c.id, c.name, c.handle, COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.price_cents * c.commission_rate)), 0) AS revenueCents,
+      COUNT(oi.prompt_id) AS units,
+      ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits), 3) AS conversionRate
+    FROM creators c LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.creator_id = c.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'paid'
+    GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenueCents DESC
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['creators']
+  const dailySales = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT o.created_at AS day, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price_cents), 0) AS revenueCents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders
+    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid'
+    GROUP BY o.created_at ORDER BY o.created_at
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['dailySales']
+  return {
+    grossRevenueCents: money.grossRevenueCents,
+    creatorRevenueCents: money.creatorRevenueCents,
+    platformRevenueCents: money.grossRevenueCents - money.creatorRevenueCents,
+    conversionRate: money.visits ? Number((money.orders / money.visits).toFixed(3)) : 0,
+    averageOrderValueCents: money.orders ? Math.round(money.grossRevenueCents / money.orders) : 0,
+    categoryRevenue,
+    creators,
+    dailySales,
+  }
+}
*** End Patch

+  const row = getDb().prepare(`${cardSelect} WHERE p.slug = @slug`).get({ slug, userId }) as RawCard | undefined
+  return row ? normalizeCard(row) : null
+}
+
+export function toggleFavorite(promptId: number, userId = DB_USER_ID) {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const exists = db.prepare('SELECT 1 FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').get(userId, promptId)
+  if (exists) db.prepare('DELETE FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').run(userId, promptId)
+  else db.prepare('INSERT INTO favorites VALUES (?, ?)').run(userId, promptId)
+  return { isFavorite: !exists, count: Number((db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM favorites WHERE user_id = ?').get(userId) as { count: number }).count) }
+}
+
+export function setCartItem(promptId: number, add: boolean, userId = DB_USER_ID) {
+  const db = getDb()
+  if (add) db.prepare('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO cart_items VALUES (?, ?, 1)').run(userId, promptId)
+  else db.prepare('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ? AND prompt_id = ?').run(userId, promptId)
+  return getCart(userId)
+}
+
+export function getCart(userId = DB_USER_ID): CartSummary {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const items = db.prepare(`${cardSelect} JOIN cart_items cart ON cart.prompt_id = p.id WHERE cart.user_id = @userId ORDER BY cart.prompt_id`).all({ userId }).map((row) => normalizeCard(row as RawCard))
+  const subtotalCents = Number((db.prepare('SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.price_cents * ci.qty), 0) AS subtotal FROM cart_items ci JOIN prompts p ON p.id = ci.prompt_id WHERE ci.user_id = ?').get(userId) as { subtotal: number }).subtotal)
+  const feeCents = Math.round(subtotalCents * 0.08)
+  return { items, subtotalCents, feeCents, totalCents: subtotalCents + feeCents }
+}
+
+export function checkout(userId = DB_USER_ID) {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const cart = getCart(userId)
+  if (cart.items.length === 0) return { ok: false, orderId: null, cart }
+  const tx = db.transaction(() => {
+    const result = db.prepare('INSERT INTO orders (user_id, status, fee_cents, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, date(\'now\'))').run(userId, 'paid', cart.feeCents)
+    const orderId = Number(result.lastInsertRowid)
+    for (const item of cart.items) db.prepare('INSERT INTO order_items VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)').run(orderId, item.id, item.priceCents, item.creatorId)
+    db.prepare('DELETE FROM cart_items WHERE user_id = ?').run(userId)
+    return orderId
+  })
+  return { ok: true, orderId: tx(), cart: getCart(userId) }
+}
+
+export function getAnalytics(): AnalyticsSummary {
+  const db = getDb()
+  const money = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(oi.price_cents), 0) AS grossRevenueCents,
+      COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.price_cents * c.commission_rate)), 0) AS creatorRevenueCents,
+      COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
+      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits) AS visits
+    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN creators c ON c.id = oi.creator_id
+    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
+  `).get() as { grossRevenueCents: number; creatorRevenueCents: number; orders: number; visits: number }
+  const categoryRevenue = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT p.category, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price_cents), 0) AS revenueCents, COUNT(*) AS units
+    FROM order_items oi JOIN prompts p ON p.id = oi.prompt_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
+    WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenueCents DESC
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['categoryRevenue']
+  const creators = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT c.id, c.name, c.handle, COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(oi.price_cents * c.commission_rate)), 0) AS revenueCents,
+      COUNT(oi.prompt_id) AS units,
+      ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visits), 3) AS conversionRate
+    FROM creators c LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.creator_id = c.id LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'paid'
+    GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY revenueCents DESC
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['creators']
+  const dailySales = db.prepare(`
+    SELECT o.created_at AS day, COALESCE(SUM(oi.price_cents), 0) AS revenueCents, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders
+    FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'paid'
+    GROUP BY o.created_at ORDER BY o.created_at
+  `).all() as AnalyticsSummary['dailySales']
+  return {
+    grossRevenueCents: money.grossRevenueCents,
+    creatorRevenueCents: money.creatorRevenueCents,
+    platformRevenueCents: money.grossRevenueCents - money.creatorRevenueCents,
+    conversionRate: money.visits ? Number((money.orders / money.visits).toFixed(3)) : 0,
+    averageOrderValueCents: money.orders ? Math.round(money.grossRevenueCents / money.orders) : 0,
+    categoryRevenue,
+    creators,
+    dailySales,
+  }
+}
*** End Patch
